items.title: Last day to cancel the electricity contract because of the price increase
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit der Anpassung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie Ihren Liefervertrag fristlos auf den Tag kündigen, an dem die neuen Preise gelten (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG).
items.computation: The new prices apply from 2025-08-01. The letter allows termination without notice period effective on that day. For the contract to end on 2025-08-01 and not run on at the new prices, the cancellation should reach the provider by the end of the day before, 2025-07-31 (a Thursday, not a holiday). The letter says an email is enough. The letter gives no other deadline, and a company letter has no deemed-delivery rule. I took the earliest safe day.

items.title: New prices and new monthly instalment take effect
items.quote: ab dem 01.08.2025 gelten für Ihren Tarif neue Preise.
items.computation: The date is printed in the letter: 2025-08-01. The monthly instalment (Abschlag) rises from 64.00 to 71.00 EUR.

warnings: The letter does not say by which day the cancellation must arrive; 2025-07-31 is the safe reading so that the contract ends on 2025-08-01. Send the email early and keep proof of it.
Price increase: Arbeitspreis 28.90 to 32.40 ct/kWh, Grundpreis 11.50 to 12.90 EUR/month, Abschlag 64.00 to 71.00 EUR.
